The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect reward score, confirming the core logic for risk assessment is functional.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.84 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 reported 100% success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the mean score is 1.000, the 20-minute runtime suggests potential inefficiencies in the environment setup or data processing that should be monitored.
